hook: Borrowman spent more than a decade inside Colgate-Palmolive's Hill's Pet Nutrition division building global digital marketing systems before moving to the European digital transformation role and then into enterprise AI. Her Davos 2026 appearance placed her in the small cohort of marketing leaders publicly shaping the governance and brand questions that agentic AI raises, specifically, how leadership principles should be embedded directly into AI architecture rather than applied after the fact.
name: Christy Borrowman

quote.text: As AI systems move from generating outputs to executing decisions, leadership principles should be embedded directly into AI architecture.

reading.body:
Christy Borrowman's career argues that enterprise AI governance is most useful when it is built into system architecture from the start, a position she stated publicly at Davos 2026 and that her professional record gives some weight to.

Her path through Hill's Pet Nutrition and then Colgate-Palmolive's European division was spent building the operational infrastructure that agentic AI now runs on: direct-to-consumer systems, contact center transformation, omni-channel workflows. That sequence matters because it means her current VP AI Transformation role is not a lateral move from communications into technology, but a continuation of the same work as the tools underneath it changed. For AI specifically, the relevance is that agentic commerce systems make autonomous purchasing and customer decisions, which raises the question of where accountability sits. Borrowman's public argument is that leadership principles have to be embedded in the architecture itself rather than applied afterward as policy.

The data covers her roles, her timeline, and one direct quotation from the Davos panel. It does not include specifics about the AI systems she has built, their scale, the compute infrastructure supporting them, or measurable outcomes from the European transformation work. The single primary source is her LinkedIn profile, so the record is self-reported. What the data does establish is her position as one of a small number of marketing-side executives engaging publicly with the governance design of agentic AI at the enterprise level.
